name: STARDUST SQUADRON
source:
It’s World War II, and a military air squadron is stationed on an island in the northern part of Japan.
Our rookie fighter pilot spends his days just repeating patrol flights and training,
but one day, everything changes when a "mysterious girl" appears on the island?!.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110820032652/http://www.techgian.jp/official/ss/story01.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
第二次世界大战期间，日本北部的一座岛屿上驻扎着一个空军中队。
我们的新秀战斗机飞行员每天都在重复巡逻飞行和训练，
但有一天，当一名“神秘女孩”出现在岛上时，一切都改变了？！

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110820032652/http://www.techgian.jp/official/ss/story01.html]官方网站[/url]]
